parole.significato: to hatch, shadow with parallel lines
parole.testo: Borrowed from Middle French hacher, with unetymological r, from Old French hacher, hachier, from Frankish *hakkōn, from Proto-Germanic *hakkōną (“to chop; hack”). Doublet of hakken.

parole.significato: raspberry, plant of the species Rubus idaeus
parole.testo: 16th century, from Middle French framboise, from Frankish *brāmabasi (from a variant of Proto-West Germanic *brāmabaʀi), whence also the inherited doublet braambes (“blackberry”).

parole.significato: a frown, a furrow of one's eyebrows or forehead
parole.testo: Borrowed from Middle French fronce, from Old French fronce, from Frankish *hrunkja (“wrinkle”) from Proto-Germanic *hrunkijō, *hrunkitō (“fold, wrinkle”), from Proto-Indo-European *sker- (“to turn, bend”). The semantic narrowing to frowns on the forehead may be influenced by unrelated Latin frōns.
